name: Textbelt
summary: Send SMS with a prepaid key and check delivery status.

api_key.description: A Textbelt key bought on textbelt.com. The public key 'textbelt' sends one free text a day; appending _test to a key checks a send without spending credit.

notes: The answer is HTTP 200 even on failure: check success, and read error ("Out of quota", "Incomplete request").
Each send answers quotaRemaining, so the balance needs no separate call.
Replies are delivered only to a replyWebhookUrl you host, and only for US numbers.

endpoints.name: Send an SMS
endpoints.summary: Text one phone number; answers success, textId and quotaRemaining.

replyWebhookUrl.description: URL that receives replies as JSON (fromNumber, text); US numbers only.

notes: Sends a real SMS and spends one credit. Keep the textId to check delivery.

endpoints.name: Check delivery status
endpoints.summary: DELIVERED, SENT, SENDING, FAILED or UNKNOWN for a sent text.
notes: Carriers do not standardise receipts: SENT means handed to the carrier without confirmation, not a failure.
